item.title: Are the Days of cPanel and Plesk Numbered?
item.description: Another year, another renewal notice from WebPros, and another round of eye-watering price increases. If you run a hosting business, you know the drill by now. Every autumn, we sit down with a spreadsheet, squint at the new licensing tiers for cPanel and Plesk, and try to work out how much of that cost we can absorb before we’re forced to pass it on to customers. Give them their dues: for years, both panels were the undisputed backbone of shared hosting.
